simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.message: This is a simulation. Nothing real happens here.

onboarding.title: Welcome to RichMode
onboarding.intro: RichMode is an entertainment app. It shows the home screen of a made-up bank, with any balance you choose.
onboarding.pointFake: Nothing here is real. There is no account, money or bank behind it.
onboarding.pointLocal: Your values stay on your device. Nothing is sent anywhere.
onboarding.pointHonest: Do not use the app to fool anyone in business, credit or sales.
